csv_project_name: CMAR For Agua Fria Pedestrian Bridge
csv_scope_of_work: The city s trail system is progressing through its development in both public and private projects to create a continuous trail from north to south across the city along the Agua Fria River. A key component for the trail system s development is a crossing across an ADOT drainage channel between the city s Friendship Park and Interstate 10. The City of Avondale (the City ) is issuing this Request For Qualifications (this RFQ ) seeking statements of qualifications ( SOQ ) from qualified, licensed Construction Manager at Risk firms ( CMAR Firms ) interested in providing Construction Manager At Risk (CMAR) for design phase review and complete construction services related to the Agua Fria Pedestrian Bridge (the Project ) and other items as deemed necessary by the City (collectively, the Services )
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Site Evaluation/Selection
